# JobFlow Resume Engine

This isolated package implements fact-grounded resume composition, proposal approval, negative
memory, immutable DOCX/PDF generation, and artifact hashing. It is licensed under Apache-2.0 so
the boundary remains compatible with the architecture and license expectations of Resume Matcher.

The implementation in this directory was written independently for JobFlow CN. No Resume Matcher
source file is vendored or copied. Resume Matcher is acknowledged as an architectural reference in
the repository-level `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
